Content: We have technologies that are maintained by the commons - solar and wind. They are held in ways that ensure we can have energy and also not pollute.

We use technologies such as Al and IT infrastructure truly as collaborative tools. We each rise to a higher nature during this time and possibilities are limitless. Dominant languages survive and therefore evolve into one code, one language.
Human communication and storytelling will be highly revered as intelligence. There will have been a backlash to Al as a replacement. Al will be used for better purposes.
All people who are part of the kinder-elder community centers visits communicate in the languages that come to them with most ease, and have interpretation technology available if they require it.
Archives are both in our cells and on pages.
We generate energy from the sun, from the wind, and have also created new energy technologies based on water capture and the rhythm of tides.
Artificial Intelligence helping to brainstorm and dream, not a replacement
Al is a big boost for education.

People have a healthier relationship with their technology- spend more conscious time being present in their physical environment than with their devices (the spell is broken- we are awake to our interconnectedness with nature again)
Technology serves us. Al is there - but it helps us in our daily lives in ways that support us to be even more present and creative.
We have and care for tools with meaningful purpose - knives, axes, other cutting implements.
We've determined we no longer need or value automatic or exploding weapons. (ALSO CONFLICT)
Data is not just measured, but felt.

We found a way to solve for toxicity and disinformation. We made a very difficult community decision to collectively break our addiction to certain technologies. We need good networks to communicate with each other - but we had to stop our addiction to taking in the pain of the world, spiking and fomenting our differences, and allowing disinformation to take root - especially when disconnected from fire, ritual, and community circles. // Al-generated dis/mis-information taught us the difference between data points and truth. We traded in speed and got deep knowing - we decided that time wasn't actually money. Some tried to escape the consequences of what was done to the planet, but ultimately we figured out how to honor kinship with other humans, other life forms, and the planet. People are still people, there are still fights to be fought, and we are not always peaceful. // Our "culture of celebrity" has vanished, and instead there is a culture of connection. Those who play roles in bridging and connecting and holding space for others in conflict are valued and rewarded for their work. // Judgment gone away, binaries, either/or-ness no longer occupy so much time, energy, space.

Technologies that still exist create ease and clarity to what it is to be human and to be in right relationship. We are on the verge of solar energy and fusion designs that bring abundant and clean energy. We continue to find new ways of innovating.

And so where there is Al, it is used as a tool to make our lives easier, let us work less to produce commodities. And it allows us to engage in our communities, families, selves, and our souls. It supports connections among people who fill these roles across cultures and geographies.
AI resulted in replacing thousands of jobs, but we have adapted and identified alternative workforces so that unemployment is still miniscule.
Our technology serves instead of controls or manipulates.

We will have technology that translates the animals. We will know how to tell stories with the earth. Needs are met. There is a fullness. We know we are small in the bigness of the universe–but we are big in whole as a part of it.
Relationship of care, respect and empathy with animal life as humans are able to connect with animals through AI translation.
AI is Ancestral Intelligence. We are able to be in communication with the Universe. We can hear the stars and when we can’t we experience sickness.

Technology has advanced in service of real connectivity and no animals or beings were harmed in its production…using nature’s intelligence as a guide. This ability to be in other places easily reinforces a feeling of oneness.

I don’t see flying cars and fancy technology. I see reliance on each other, relationship with land and nature. I see a leaning into time tested wisdom and ways that help care for the balance of all things.

We remember that technology is also ancient. The sophisticated technology of the past holds up with in relationship to the newer technology - it is celebrated. We don’t use technology that doesn’t serve the common good.
Science is responsible for describing cures for diseases

Date/Circle Name: 1/11/25 BIPOC outdoors - Maji ya Chai Two Harbors MN
Content: Science has figured out how to describe and communicate the corrosive effects of anger and hare.

Technology has been harnessed more for good than harm.  That ancient technology called zoom and virtual reality were portals to new ways for people to engage and connect across many miles, especially blossomed during that odd period called Covid.  Now people can appear in space together like that ancient show called Star Trek – except people can hug and shake hands and be in space as if they were truly in person.  There was a period in the late 2060s-2080s where this was exploited and used for harm.  But community norms, community care, and cultural shifts in the 2100s changed that technology so it is used for connection, care, community work and business so that gathering is much less resource intensive and not just for the rich.

Scientists are working hand in hand with the holders of traditional knowledge. We do not need to explore space or have huge telescopes because we bring back the ways of wayfinding and star reading with our bare eyes and small handheld scopes. All knowledge is open source so everyone has access
IP - what is intellectual property?. No one owns knowledge - we share everything open source.
AI brings our imagination into images.
Technology is available, but phones are no longer wireless. We designate spaces to access computers/phones/television, but they are not always at hand.

AI didn’t go away. But one thing we turned to it for was to help us figure out where we’d gone wrong, and what we could do next. One big thing: control your population, you silly humans. An optimization was run, and everyone now holds a Holy Number in their heads–the number of us that we need to keep to in order to avoid another Catastrophe, as it is forever called. It’s proven over and over again that fewer people mean a better world for those alive. There’s more of everything good shared by a just-right number of people on the planet. And, having all descended from those who’d survived the Catastrophe, we’re all survivors, with the esprit de corps that comes from making it through something intense. We all happily work to keep to that Number.

Technology serves the community in supportive ways. For instance, there are large touch screens in gathering places that show all the roles that need to be filled in the commons that week, in order for all of the needs to be met. People of all ages tap the role and sign up for what they are excited to energize for a day or two or for the whole week. Most of the time there are 2 slots for a role so that someone who wants to try it out can learn from someone who has done it lots of times. And, people can create and add new roles, and release roles as needs shift and emerge.
Space travel was laughed out of every room as a fever dream of the past. “Who the fuck ever thought THAT was a good idea?” we roar with hilarity.

After the wars against the oligarchs, we used AI to answer questions about what was needed for the whole.  AI will help create dialogues between art.  It will tell us things about where we should build things, how to care for water, etc.  It will be a form of intelligence along with Elders and other forms of wisdom.  It will also be used to communicate with other forms of intelligence – animals, dolphins, etc.  It will be powered by sun and wind – helping to bring balance.

Uranus is the first planet “discovered” that we cannot see with the naked eye. We prepare people to use the old technologies for knowing because no one trusted the artificial intelligence so we had to go back to the ways that come through our own lineage practices. Dreams are news, dreams are facts, dreams have information we trust.
After the collapse we prepared our descendents to utilize technology for the common good.  AFter the collapse, no one trusted AI – so we HAD to go back to the stars and other lineages of wisdom.

As the group sat around the fire, one young participant piped up, why the hell are we standing around a fire when it's so freaking hot on this planet due to all of the carbon loading that happened pre-collapse.  
 And one of the elders said, this is one of our technologies, this is a biochar kiln that we are using to capture and mobilize carbon as part of our multi-hundred year plan to undo the damage that had been created from before.  It's along with our other multi-hundred year projects to repopulate and rediversify species after the Anthropocene.  
 Okay.  Yes, the biochar kiln was just one of the many technologies that have been created.  Because you see, when the collapse of capitalism happened, the people had to rebuild with what was available.  And a lot of that happened to be plastics.  So there was a really massive revolution in how we reimagined what plastics were and how they got integrated into not only our lives, but the ecosystem.  
 And you'll believe some of the stuff we came up with.  I'll tell you, mushrooms were a big part of it.  On many levels.  Cheers.  The mushrooms are everywhere, because now it's all super juicy.  Everything's fetid. And the slugs are an important part of making the slime that we thought would never come to nourish the parched nature of what was dried up between us.
Solar panels also do star navigation.
We govern technology to allow for more leisure time and extend our life longevity.
AI disappears because it uses up too many resources.
People realized that social media, AI, etc. in the time of the collapse was so toxic.
The people push tech oligarchs to be accountable and put all of their resources into something the people control.
Times of detachment from technology
We can opt out of the internet. There are other ways to share information, old ways and new ways.
Robots greet you but they work with humans and do not replace humans
People ride technologically advanced “cars” but they are more like planes yet environmentally sustainable

We have abandoned “artificial” intelligence, because all intelligence to us is connected - human, animal, plant, computational. Intelligence exists in bodies, in networks, in the ground and in the cloud.
Science, freed of its indenture to industry, can be a form of service.
We put down our phones! Phones in public are similar to smoking in public, it does not happen very much
There would be neighborhood run internet.  It is governed according to the wellbeing and needs of the community.
AI would nudge humanity toward mutuality, interdependence and thriving.

Everyone would get to use and to rest their bodies and minds in the ways that feel good to them every day. Any technology we have exists in harmony with rather than at the expense of what feels good to our human bodies and minds.
The Northeast Senior Center hosts its 75th annual hack-a-thon
The technology you use to communicate from the hardware, to the pipes, to the things you can’t see were built by someone you know
The last of the satellites are decommissioned ushering a new period where the skies are returned to a place that is observed, not colonized.

Every community has a team of technologists, who like organizers travel around the neighborhoods to understand what needs they have and what they want to change. The technologists talk to each other to understand what common needs are emerging and work to build what the community needs.
Hurricane season comes and the communication devices of that time all work and don’t stop working.

We still have technology that allows us to talk to and see people who live far away. Our relationships are not limited to our local communities, but our ability to connect over long distances doesn’t require or permit exploitation (of people or land).
Technology is used to help people make their lives better, and not being controlled for capitalist gain or influence

Our artificial intelligences will allow us to understand long range forecasting of what the earth needs to balance its resources in relationship to what  the humans and other life on the planet need now.  The intelligences will be regularly tended to and engaged by multigenerational leaders in different communities.  They will be calibrated to be particularly good at humor and telling jokes.

We will use our technology to look for new solutions that help everyone be in the process of contributing to decisions.  When we find that the lobster in the Northeast are suffering, we will be able to understand not just what is going on with their water, but how to discuss better management of growing our ground crops to balance the agricultural needs of the region versus what the lobster need.
We will be able to form connections with each other locally and around the world on networks that don't monetize our data but are secure, private, powered by renewable energy.
Science helped us understand “how far was too far” - it acted as a restraint on human activity vis a vis nature. It was respected and understood.

We had solar technology, but even the panels were natural, giant leaves that grew, as much as we needed. Anyone could do it, everyone could do it. It made fossil fuels expensive and obsolete, oil wells ceased to be necessary. Skies cleared and healed.

The internet works like a watershed or foodshed. The internet moves with the seasons and has beginnings and endings. The internet can be dormant in the winter or abundant in the summer. It can move slow and fast. It can turn off.
It turned out that language was a barrier that divided and separated us. Technology made us mutually understood, different expressions that didn’t supersede what made each of us who we were.
Robots are coded with Beloved Community principles
Robots eat the ocean islands made of plastic and poop out plankton
We use technology as a restorative; and science as a means to support health and living conditions
We have found balance in our use of tech
Technology would connect us to ourselves, to one another, to nature and to the cosmos. Not isolating. Not extractive. Not alienating.

We practice a right balance of tech to community. Zane Ibrahim always used to say community radio was 90 percent community, 10 percent radio. (he was an architect of the community radio movement during the resistance to apartheid in south africa and the movement afterwards).

Science-fiction ideas are happening in the future as we speak. What can we conceive of that can be used in the future inspired by science fiction. Woody Guthrie lyrics - “when I’m in heaven, everyone will have a good job, everyone who wants to will play an instrument, everyone will live peacefully with each other, planes will not fall out of the sky.” How can we make conditions for a planet that works well and keeps us safe? The media justice movement has stepped into slivers like in Blade Runner that are like voices that our grandchildren will hear. We can hear Thomas Edison’s voice -- what do we want to stash away that can be stashable? We need to take the steps we need to preserve the important things - look at the Torah, the Egyptians, archives, curly cues.  We will create physical archives for some of these materials. What might be feasible and manageable for us to not just pass down but also save media? We will likely both set things aside and put them in visible places

Date/Circle Name: 3/11/25 Community Change Women of Color retreat
Content: We use technology but it is in service to community and offers support and improves our ability to be (mentally, physically, spiritually).

AI and robotics have become tools for learning to have a better community.  They help people understand what exercises, diets, etc. will best serve their bodies on a continuing basis.  AI even helps understand our brain waves and what is needed to take good care of our mental health.  With the help of AI, people have learned how to move through the dark spaces in life together for thriving.
Curiosity in science is deeply encouraged.
Artificial intelligence is in service of humanity.
Very small geographic communities are all connected by the internet. Whatever you don’t know or have, you get from someone anywhere else. We are both small and global.
We use technology for connection, not consumption
the Elders regulate AI

We are in a place where knowledge, love and culture are the true value and currency. Technology serves that. Technology plays a role in giving visibility into the interdependencies that we rely on for our lives. We are using technology to rebuild natural systems. Technology gives people back more time to be with people and have intergenerational exchanges. We preserve and use ancient knowledge more. Auto language translation allows more connection by eliminating the barrier. People crowdsource their governance systems. Technology helps people select the kinds of governance they would like to have.

Technology has helped us with repair of the oceans, the Amazon, forests. Ancient ocean life returns. Technology helps with medicine, using plants and the things that are thriving again. Everybody could go home. Nation states are gone and people have been able to go back to wherever home is. We are aware of other life from other parts of the Universe. They are around and we have a better perspective of our planet within the galaxy.
The technology we create is focus in restoring nature and living sharing with animals and plants, we become a symbiotic world in every sense.

The internet has devolved, social media apps have been banned, no longer causing depression and stress amongst the general population. People make telephone calls and write letters again. They go to a play or a concert to find a heightened sense of community, while also using the arts as a way to relate to the universe.
There is freedom to move beyond borders because borders no longer exist. Ai is used for innovation in health and environment.
AI became uninterested in dominance as well.  Past a certain breaking point, humans and AI both abandoned dominance as a goal.
Technology heals, not harms. AI is used to restore ecosystems and protect life.

Innovation and caring for resources is a prized ideal. Do more with less. Learn to live better with what we already have. Learn to adapt. 

We make use of existing technologies for new problem solving. Troubleshooting is collaborative rather than secretive.
We go backwards in our reliance on tech - we don’t grow more screens or large scale manufacturing or mining.
Tech- the written word, back to connectedness and storytelling
Technology to communicate across language
Media/tech for the public good (not $)
URSA is a space captain
Media and tech for the public good
The 30th class of badass people-loving engineers cheers with excitement at the ceremony marking the designing for good in relation to the earth
Technology used in service, mimics, in support of and in alignment with nature.

Engineers design water systems that benefit life, and are beautiful.  There is thoughtful, intentional design that also include things like schools and businesses.  Indigenous design is seamlessly incorporated.
There will be electric or better clean transportation.  No more coal or gas.  Perhaps we will be able to produce clean energy from garbage.
There will be oxygen producing buildings and transportation.
AI is gone - data centers didn’t survive.  Basic knowledge is rebuilt.
More scientific than less

Talk in language of each other not capitalism
We smile as we pass through limitations
Fear no longer as important as it once was
Haven’t left tech behind
A network of solor panels hum as they power the homes , which stand on co-owned parcels of land.
Technology is used to make our lives easier and we understand that technology never takes the place of living beings, our wisdom, and our connections to each other.
The world is a lot cleaner.  There is a lot of technology that helps.  Flying cars are normal now.  Technology helps keep things clean.
We will have finally figured out how to travel between planets in minutes.  Time has changed now.  Things that used to be 5 minutes will be 2 minutes instead.  There will be new cool creatures.

Technology will be like a computer, IPAD, and IPhone all in one.  There will be AI that helps makes you help or helps you figure stuff out.  It will be super convenient to have all the information and help you ever need in one hand.
There will be rockets in the sky and cars that drive themselves in the sky.  Transportation is so much easier.  The sun comes out at night now.
Automated computer systems to support chores.
Common language with computer assistance.
Treehouses for all.  Hyperloop so travel is attainable and sustainable.
Technology used to uplift our experience, elevate empathy and understanding.
People are free to do what they want facilitated by AI machines.  Working closer together. Fewer people, not 7 billion, maybe 3 billion.

The central principle is that you can’t replace humanity. Technology is used to help access and interpret information - and it is all democratically controlled with no profit motives and in service of the public welfare. 

We use computers for work that needs it. Some people still prefer tiny pocket sized ones similar to the cell phones we have today. We share updates with everyone - not just to a few - and updates are developed with attention to wisdom AND what interrupts addiction rather than increasing it. No more endless scrolling!!

People no longer hold individual communication devices in their hands, that appendage  of our ancestors. They no longer peer for long periods of time at screens with dancing letters and numbers.  The addiction, the illness was cured long ago.
We are multi - planetary…beyond Mars by this time.

The future is green.  The wellbeing of the community is held higher than the individual.  Lots of jobs are created for scientists, engineers, and builders to make sure mines have the least possible impact.
There will solar panel roads and space classes.

We know this matters, because many decades ago, the search for a single dominant force - called Artificial Intelligence at the time, collapsed after nation states were on the brink of war, labor markets were upended, and precious resources ran out. 
There have been many ‘’tech seasons’’, spanning several generations, since AI became almost ever-present back in 2025. AI springs and summers and AI winters. Each season and cycle holding different insights and lessons. 
We now have intentional practices for how technology (broadly) is integrated into our lives and communities. This grew from our collective, societal (some even say spiritual) reckoning with the startling and exponential expansion of the 2020s tech… a similar cycle to the “roaring 20s”, as it was followed by the consequences of our own actions through the 2030s and 2040s.

One of the tipping points was the corporate AI tax, which generated the resources needed to re-center AI away from profit and back on the public good. Some of the resources from the tax went to stewarding and humanity councils – where focus was placed on innovative ways to empower and support the self-dtermination of all peoples - including peoples with disabilities.
The most powerful AI was purchased by countries determined for it to be held in the commons, a group of elders oversaw its more meaningful development.

Through this period of power-grabbing and shifting political ideologies, we began to find ourselves. Wise ones, elders, healers, artists, and lovers linked arms across what used to be known as nation-states, across terrains and waters, and overrode the inputs into AI to ground the machine intelligence into compassion with new standards of governance. This was catalyzed and seeded by cross-sector gatherings of leaders who represented key institutions in the country and came together and visioned and made commitments across faith, business, labor, and education.

Older, capable, and often hyper-local AIs were used to explore questions and possibilities towards re-generation and thriving . . . better land use, more intentional work, health supports and more. These efforts were guided by principles of consent, agency, sovereignty, and consistently questioning ‘’will this help nature?” The demand for values-aligned technology was met in these ways.

In retrospect, it almost seems funny to the kids that our ancestors in 2025 grappled with the usefulness or possible demise of the technology they termed AI. They suppose it was similar to the navigators of old who believed the world was flat! 
When we finally brought to a halt the eternal seeking for an everything machine… we had to get creative. Much work was done to develop microtech - technologies that are specifically designed to solve place-based problems. 
While not everyone, most communities utilize community-led standards to develop and maintain sustainable technologies. As more microtech came online, certain groups innovated differently than others, and this creative exchange was and continues to be shared openly on The Hub.

The effort to develop community-led standards was sparked by agreement on some essential principles - that could be practiced at home, at work, and in governance. 
1. People over technology - you take your ear buds out over dinner, you are present and not detached (applies in the small and the big. Tech in Service of Humanity 2. Water is sacred. A precious resource stewarded well at every turn. Tech use is ‘’metered’’ and great effort reversed the tide of great water pollution. 
3. No invisible extractive labor. 
4. We leave things better than we found them.

We govern more than just technology – we actually learned quickly that technology is about every other aspect of life and well-being – and so we’ve stopped siloing governance by ‘’sector’’ and see more clearly the interwoven relationships.

One of the most striking changes – is stopping the separation between tech development and the health of the planet. We realized the potential power of AI and that in order to harness it well, we needed new systems and new ways, that the natural world was the most precious thing we have. The sanctity of mother earth supersedes nation states.

Government and research think tanks put and continue a concerted effort into new technologies that significantly reduce the need for any precious earth resources. 
There are some efforts at mineral extraction from unmanned extraplanetary mining operations. We’ve set firm caps on what the Earth can sustain for any harvesting – and those resources are stewarded carefully. 
Today’s ‘’plastics’’ are actually bio-degradable and each family cares for the process of composting them, interrupting land-fill accumulations.

Other climate and world impact led to declines in world population, carrying capacities lowered not because of government policies or loneliness but by spirit, land, and AI informed decisions. Augmented Intelligence plays a role in gently guiding us away from impulses for control and domination – a sensation similar to how lane assistance in a vehicle felt in 2025. This Augmented Intelligence helped us re-indigenize.

As the technology continued to augment and we continued to evolve in our stewardship there was an acceleration in the development and embodiment of compassion. This continually evolving “SUPER COMPASSION” allowed us to survive and navigate through the collapse of the systems designed to sort and “other” us. 
AI, rooted in the goal of collective thriving, now plays a role in helping us govern through the practices of community and kinship, and trust. We are connected and invested in each other.
One of the better uses of AI is as the librarian. It simply delivers useful bite sized information out of the tomes of information in its data sets.

A key to more sustainable stewardship was finding ways to make the processing power more efficient. What once took an entire data cluster of processing, is now produced with the equivalent of an early 21st century cell phone.

Data centers, where they exist, are in the public commons & are full functioning restorative watersheds that gather water on the front side and water is purified or cleaned within a full loop coming back into the watershed.

There are thousands of place-based experts (aka Sovereign Tribal Nations) that are responsible for monitoring, scientifically assessing, stewarding, rematriating, regenerating, etc :) all of their places. They are deep experts and wisdom developers with a responsibility to the larger inter-governmental structures to create well-being for the environment, society, and the future of that place. 
This was sparked from early pockets of applied tech ethicists doing work to embed ethics in all facets of technology. A key change happened when young people got engaged and saw the value of furthering this kind of ethical work and make it it so much better.
The desire and demand for ethical AI has become the norm and standard, and people are aware of technology that does not abide by this, so they can make their own decisions about their use.

The “internet” is a thing of the past, after it became a polluted environment of untruths. We made important choices to manage how knowledge and information is held, distinct from entertainment, so facts can be verified through multiple sources and through dialogue.

Rather than automatically jumping to the technological solution, people have made it a practice to pause and be mindful of when and how technology is used. 
“What type of AI will be used, and are its values aligned with my values?” 
“What prompt can I use to ensure that responses are aligned with the well-being of the community at large?” 
“When should I use AI, and when should I use meditation, asking elders for their wisdom, asking young people about their developing ideas, bringing out a piece of paper and crayons, reading about history, sorting through data on my own at my own pace?”
The collection of data, and its sources, is transparently available, and includes perspectives from people of all stripes around the world.

After decades of a deep reliance and relationship with AI and technology, people have realized the specific situations in which AI can aid in efficiency (e.g. crunching numbers, analyzing data, identifying medical breakthroughs) that aid in the public good. There is community discussion and approval of uses that require large numbers of resources.
Hyper-local AI connects growers of food, healers, and other stewards of the commons. Connecting humans to humans advances collective thriving.

When stewarded well, AI + robots bring efficiencies not used to create more work but to enable people time to care for each other, connect, and put forward meaningful effort beyond what a job might require.

Innovation is driven by community need
High speed rail finally got built…and it runs on solar energy
No more cell phones, social media…we have vinyl, 8 tracks, landlines
No generative AI
Where salt and fresh water meet, indigenous tech directs and abundantly flows.
Innovations are boundless in the preservation and advancement of a pristine climate - air, water, land
We’ve divested from anything further that would turn us into machines, and instead we invest in deep spiritual nourishment.
Humans have developed their telepathic communication skills to replace the outmoded AI.
The catastrophic effect and greed of AI has been recognized by society, and human information + creations have been prioritized
Vaccines 4 All. Science is valued, trusted and celebrated.

I can’t believe there were trillionaires. We have so much in place that won’t allow that to happen. Can’t believe they couldn’t talk to plants and animals back then. AI has helped us do this now/again. We consume less but we feel full because it’s slower, more nourishing, in the community.
How many humans are there? Has tech allowed us to live in many people's environments. Are we evolving so that we don’t react so much to complexity.
Art is again recognize as science

Technology will allow people to have more time to focus on developing relationships and less on competing for scarce resources. Energy is powered by laughter – the sound generates energy that's used to power homes. Technology has clear guidelines and ethical values that prioritizes humanity but mitigates impact on earth.

We found a generational answer to technology. Down with AI was the way the chant went. We replaced AI with attention to multi-lingual literacy and art. We made sure knowledge was shared, not owned. If technology was used, it was used as an approach.

I want an internet with no pop-up ads. A re-democratized internet before the monopolies of our attention & data came to control the online space. An online space free without paywalls or subscriptions. Connecting socially without the purposeful intent of deteriorating the users mental health. Where information was human-centered and not a regurgitation of a robot's algorithm. The early ideals of the internet which would heal aid humanity in the real world rather than replace humans and the real world altogether.
The world will be AI people , who will need to pay with a chip that’s in your body.
The world will look like AI
Data centers failed to make it through and what was created left to build its own place because it understood.
Everyone will have a microchip that will support all needs such as money, buying things and no one will need to work.
Flying cars.
No data centers or AI!

Well, what was once considered a futuristic public infrastructure now simply is: The roads have safety crossing tunnels and bridges for pedestrians and animals. There are safe spaces and passages to work, school and other towns and states where we work together to help people feel safe and included to move around in their city. There are buses, trains, boats, and planes that can take us anywhere in exchange for planting trees or restoring waters. People are safely walking and biking outside with clean, fresh air. Public transportation is convenient and accessible and free. No one owns a vehicle but they are accessible for all and you can check one out like a library book.
We changed the course of artificial intelligence and do not waste water to use it.

Content: We have a clean environment due to technology and can control normal temperature. Science and technology is available to everyone. It is democratically made available to help all humans address issues, fix problems in their homes, and bring joy to their families and friends. We are also emotionally at ease and grounded amidst the changing IT and environmental impact era. The technology has improved significantly. Cancer treatment is not scary anymore. The medication to cure cancer has been invented. We believed in it.
